title: Muskets & Flintlocks Resourcepack
body:
Dependancy resourcepack for the mod [Musket's & Flintlocks](https://modrinth.com/mod/kekusis-muskets-flintlocks). This will not do anything on it's own.
Feel free to modify the contents of this pack, whether it's to mess around or change the models to you own. Distributed under the MIT license.
